text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, while out with Haru Urara—

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Look at that crane game, see, the plushies 
are—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking in the direction Haru Urara 
pointed, I saw a crane game filled with 
plushies themed after Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
It's super cute, isn't it~♪ I'm so 
jealous……

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I really wanna give that fluffy thing a 
big, tight hug...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With sparkling eyes, Haru Urara gazed at 
the plushie.
choice_data_list: —In that case, I'll get it for you!
—In that case, I'll get it for you!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Then I'll cheer you on from right by your 
side~ Do your best!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —I can't afford to lose this game!!
